params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results per page. Maximum of 10000.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset to start pagination search results.

params.name: total
params.description:
By default the `total` field in pagination responses is set to `null` to provide the fastest possible response times. Set `total` to `true` for this field to be populated.

See our [Pagination Docs](https://developer.pagerduty.com/docs/rest-api-v2/pagination/) for more information.

params.name: date_range
params.description: When set to all, the since and until parameters and defaults are ignored.

params.name: incident_key
params.description: Incident de-duplication key. Incidents with child alerts do not have an incident key; querying by incident key will return incidents whose alerts have alert_key matching the given incident key.

params.name: service_ids[]
params.description: Returns only the incidents associated with the passed service(s). This expects one or more service IDs.

params.name: team_ids[]
params.description: An array of team IDs. Only results related to these teams will be returned. Account must have the `teams` ability to use this parameter.

params.name: user_ids[]
params.description: Returns only the incidents currently assigned to the passed user(s). This expects one or more user IDs. Note: When using the assigned_to_user filter, you will only receive incidents with statuses of triggered or acknowledged. This is because resolved incidents are not assigned to any user.

params.name: urgencies[]
params.description: Array of the urgencies of the incidents to be returned. Defaults to all urgencies. Account must have the `urgencies` ability to do this.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: Time zone in which results will be rendered. This will default to the account time zone.

params.name: statuses[]
params.description: Return only incidents with the given statuses. To query multiple statuses, pass `statuses[]` more than once, for example: `https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents?statuses[]=triggered&statuses[]=acknowledged`. (More status codes may be introduced in the future.)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Used to specify both the field you wish to sort the results on (incident_number/created_at/resolved_at/urgency), as well as the direction (asc/desc) of the results. The sort_by field and direction should be separated by a colon. A maximum of two fields can be included, separated by a comma. Sort direction defaults to ascending. The account must have the `urgencies` ability to sort by the urgency.

params.name: include[]
params.description: Array of additional details to include.

params.name: since
params.description: The start of the date range over which you want to search. Maximum range is 6 months and default is 1 month.

params.name: until
params.description: The end of the date range over which you want to search. Maximum range is 6 months and default is 1 month.
